description: This file implements a package for computing approximate quantiles over data streams, including classes and methods for stream management, sampling, merging, and querying quantiles.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Holds an observed value and meta information for compression.

classes.name: Samples
classes.description: Slice of Sample objects, implements sort.Interface.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Main class for computing quantiles over a data stream, supports insertion, querying, merging, and resetting.

classes.name: stream
classes.description: Underlying data structure for Stream, manages internal state and compression logic.

methods.name: NewLowBiased
methods.description: Creates a new stream for low-biased quantiles with specified epsilon.

methods.name: NewHighBiased
methods.description: Creates a new stream for high-biased quantiles with specified epsilon.

methods.name: NewTargeted
methods.description: Creates a new stream focused on specific quantile targets with associated errors.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new value into the stream.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Returns the approximate quantile value for a given q.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges additional samples into the stream (noted as broken in comments).

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream to initial state.

methods.name: Samples
methods.description: Returns the current samples from the stream.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns total number of samples observed.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Sorts and merges buffered samples into the main stream.

methods.name: maybeSort
methods.description: Sorts samples if not already sorted.

methods.name: flushed
methods.description: Checks if the stream has been flushed.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a sample into the underlying stream.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges samples into the underlying stream (noted as inaccurate in comments).

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of samples in the underlying stream.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs quantile query on the underlying stream.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses the stream samples to maintain accuracy.

methods.name: samples
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stream samples.
